question: Where’s the closest restaurant as you go toward LVH Coordinated Allentown, Allentown, PA from Nebula Gallery, Chester, PA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS restaurant WHERE restaurant.amenity = 'restaurant' ORDER BY ST_Distance( restaurant.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Nebula Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chester%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%LVH Coordinated Allentown%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Allentown%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
